title: Baba Idhar Na
body:
hua ye shor ke ghode se gir gaye akbar
hussain aaye hai maqtal mein ghutniyo chal kar
sar apne laal ka zaanu pe shaah ne rakkha
zaeef baap ye kadiyal jawan se bola
rakha hai haath kaleje pe kyun mere beta
hata le haath ke ab phat raha hai dil mera
hata ke haathon ko kehne laga pisar baba
jo ho sakega to na dekhna idhar baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bole akbar apne baba se idhar na dekhna
ay mere baba mera zakhmi jigar na dekhna
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki khaatir bada hi sakht hai bete ka gham
naujawan hoon jis ghadi baba mera niklega dam
mera chehra us ghadi mere pidar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
door hat jaana mere seene se barchi khaynch kar
khoon niklega uchal kar mere seene se agar
dil to tadpega bahot baba magar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
rok kar akbar ko sarwar ne kaha mere hilal
imtihan e sabr hai ye baap ka ay mere laal
ab mujhe kuch dayr ay mere pisar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
aasteen apni chadha kar jab mai khaynchunga sina
waasta tujhko tere baba ka ay kadiyal jawan
meri jaanib ay mere noor e nazar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir kiya qaime ka rukh akbar ne rokar ye kaha
doobta hai karbala mein chaand ay amma tera
chaand ki jaanib kabhi ab umr bhar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
hichkiyan jab maut ki aayi to bola naujawan
aap par qurban ho akbar ay mere baba jaan
godh ke paale ka ye mushkil safar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay surani ro pada dil maine jis dam ye likha
aakhri saanson mein di sughra ko akbar ne sada
ab mera rasta behen shaam o sehar na dekhna
bole akbar apne baba se...
author: Ali Raza Surani
